DIAGNOSIS READY: Allergic Contact Dermatitis

The biopsy findings of spongiosis (intraepidermal edema and widened intercellular spaces) are consistent with your chronic, pruritic rash. Given the location on the upper extremities and the duration, this is highly suggestive of an allergic reaction to a substance you may have been in prolonged contact with, such as fragrances, nickel, or certain topical products. I will review any available images to confirm the pattern of the lesions before finalizing the treatment plan.
